import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

from io import StringIO
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a comprehensive visualization with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(df))

# 1. Price vs Megapixels with size = weight
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['megapixels'], df['price_usd'], 
                     s=df['weight_grams']/2, alpha=0.6, c=colors, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels\n(size = weight)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    ax1.annotate(row['brand'], (row['megapixels'], row['price_usd']), 
                fontsize=8, alpha=0.7)

# 2. Price by Brand
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
brands = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values()
ax2.barh(brands.index, brands.values, color=sns.color_palette("coolwarm", len(brands)))
ax2.set_xlabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Average Price by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Sensor Type Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
ax3.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        colors=sns.color_palette("pastel"), startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Weight vs Price
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax4.scatter(df['weight_grams'], df['price_usd'], c=colors, s=150, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax4.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Weight vs Price', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3)
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    ax4.annotate(row['brand'], (row['weight_grams'], row['price_usd']), 
                fontsize=8, alpha=0.7)

# 5. Model Year Timeline
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax5.scatter(df['model_year'], df['price_usd'], c=colors, s=150, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax5.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Price Over Model Years', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 6. Max ISO Comparison
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
iso_data = df.sort_values('max_iso')
ax6.barh(range(len(iso_data)), iso_data['max_iso'], 
         color=sns.color_palette("viridis", len(iso_data)))
ax6.set_yticks(range(len(iso_data)))
ax6.set_yticklabels(iso_data['brand'] + ' ' + iso_data['model_year'].astype(str), fontsize=9)
ax6.set_xlabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Max ISO by Camera', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 7. Body Type Distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
ax7.bar(body_counts.index, body_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette("muted", len(body_counts)))
ax7.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Body Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 8. 4K Video Capability
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
video_4k = df['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
labels = ['No 4K', '4K']
ax8.pie(video_4k.values, labels=[labels[i] for i in video_4k.index], autopct='%1.1f%%',
        colors=['#ff9999', '#66b3ff'], startangle=90)
ax8.set_title('4K Video Capability', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 9. Feature Summary Table
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax9.axis('off')
summary_stats = pd.DataFrame({
    'Metric': ['Avg Price', 'Avg MP', 'Avg Weight', 'Max ISO Range'],
    'Value': [
        f"${df['price_usd'].mean():.2f}",
        f"{df['megapixels'].mean():.1f}",
        f"{df['weight_grams'].mean():.0f}g",
        f"{df['max_iso'].min()}-{df['max_iso'].max()}"
    ]
})
table = ax9.table(cellText=summary_stats.values, colLabels=summary_stats.columns,
                  cellLoc='left', loc='center', colWidths=[0.5, 0.5])
table.auto_set_font_size(False)
table.set_fontsize(9)
table.scale(1, 2)
ax9.set_title('Summary Statistics', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=20)

plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
